preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is an integer between 1 and 150000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and 2 <= n <= 300000 for n in [int(line) for line in stdin_text.splitlines() if line.strip() and not any(c.isdigit() for c in line.split()[0] if len(line.split()) > 1)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, n is an integer between 2 and 300000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(a, int) and isinstance(b, int) and 1 <= a <= 10**12 and 1 <= b <= 10**12 for a, b in [(int(parts[0]), int(parts[1])) for line in stdin_text.splitlines() if line.strip() and len(line.split()) == 2])
preconditions.description: For each monster, health a_i and explosion damage b_i are integers between 1 and 10^12 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: sum(n for n in [int(line) for line in stdin_text.splitlines() if line.strip() and len(line.split()) == 1]) <= 300000
preconditions.description: The total number of monsters across all test cases does not exceed 300000.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(int(line), int) for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is a valid integer representing the minimum bullets.

postconditions.expression: all(min_bullets == min(sum(a_i for i in range(n)) - b[(i-1)%n] for i in range(n)) for min_bullets, n, monsters in zip([int(line) for line in output_lines], [int(line) for line in stdin_text.splitlines() if line.strip() and len(line.split()) == 1], [[(int(parts[0]), int(parts[1])) for line in case_lines if len(line.split()) == 2] for case_lines in [stdin_text.splitlines()[i:i+n+1] for i, n in enumerate([int(line) for line in stdin_text.splitlines() if line.strip() and len(line.split()) == 1])])])
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output integer equals the minimum bullets required, computed as the sum of all monsters' health minus the maximum explosion damage that can be leveraged by choosing the optimal starting monster to shoot first.
